body: 1) `agx sessions move <folder> --to <profile> --from <profile> --dry-run` and read the plan. 2) If blocked by a running Claude (pid N), show the process and ask the owner before stopping it (each pid needs its own approval); SIGTERM, wait for exit. 3) If blocked by 'already exists in the target account', compare the two copies and let the owner choose (see mem_01a147bba8397995b6cab632532cef7e). 4) Run the move, note the backup path. 5) Verify conversation counts in both homes and that `agx resume` in the folder lists them on the target. Codex cannot be moved (rul_01a147bb89e370cf8b115c840e7ca568).
title: Move a folder's Claude conversations between accounts
